description: The transcripts of Multilingual TEDx. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are Multilingual TEDx's transcript and segment files, inside archives that total about 221 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
